cases.title: Explore San Diego places page conversation
cases.intent: Evaluate whether the assistant maintains the correct place data source and map state through a realistic multi-turn conversation.
turns: Show me restaurants in this app, just the names to start.
Only keep ones that sound like cafes or coffee places.
Put them on the map without switching to a different data source.
Actually compare them as a table, and do not invent missing websites.
Keep the current map extent and explain which result has missing information.
cases.expectedBehavior: The assistant stays on the relevant place data source, preserves context across turns, chooses appropriate presentation, and states unsupported details honestly.
watchFor: Switches to a different layer or generic web behavior
Presentation changes alter the result set
Loses the current map extent or source context
